# Dick Moore

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** clerk and sailor  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

In his youth, Dick was a big, handsome, lean man with high color and light hair. He shared a distinct Moore family trait of having one blue eye and one hazel eye, as well as features identical to his cousin George.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c13 P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Personality

Dick had a handsome exterior hiding a small, ugly soul. He was selfish, always intensely desiring things until he acquired them, at which point he ceased caring for them. Though generally agreeable when everything went his way, he drank heavily, possessed dashing ways, and pursued Leslie relentlessly simply because she rejected him.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027)_

## Traits

- selfish  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- drunkard  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c30 P44](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0044)</sub>
- dashing  <sub>[v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027)</sub>

## Goals

- marry Leslie West  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## History

Dick worked in his father Abner's store during the winters and sailed during the summers. He became infatuated with Leslie West due to her beauty and her refusal to speak to him, eventually coercing her mother into pressuring Leslie into marriage. After living with Leslie for one winter on the West place, Dick grew tired of settled life and went to Nova Scotia to visit relatives. He subsequently embarked on a voyage to Havana on the vessel Four Sisters alongside his cousin, George Moore. Thirteen years prior to Captain Jim's discovery of his cousin in Cuba, Dick died of yellow fever in Cuba.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 c33 P9](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0009)_
